title: Thai Chicken Toast
description: A simple recipe for a delicious Thai-inspired chicken toast. The combination of crispy chicken and flavorful sauce on top of toasted bread is a perfect snack.
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and garlic.
Brush the toasted bread with the sauce mixture and top with the cooked chicken.
Place the bread under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until the top is toasted and crispy.
